main_result.result: Added a durable sidecar RESERVE/COMMIT ledger keyed by block+slot and bound to the exact launch capability, request-binding digest and deterministic attempt_id. The default recovery policy is fail-closed unresolved, preventing a second stochastic attempt after a crash. An explicit deterministic-replay policy can reissue only the same attempt identity after recovery.
main_result.permit_epoch: AttemptLaunchPermit is HMAC-bound to a process-epoch secret. A permit from a simulated crashed/restarted process was rejected; deterministic replay required an explicit new permit derived from the same durable reservation and same attempt identity.
main_result.stress: All 901 partial reservation-ack cuts were rejected; exact ack issued a valid permit. Duplicate and conflicting same-slot reservations were rejected. Fail-closed reservation recovery refused replay. COMMIT changed recovery disposition to committed_no_relaunch and invalidated the permit.

measurement_validity_rules: Durably authorizing a slot is not enough to prevent stochastic retry selection; one statistical attempt identity must also be durably reserved before score generation.
Default crash recovery after RESERVE but before durable SLOT is unresolved/no-relaunch, not automatic retry. This sacrifices data to avoid a choose-among-retries channel.

A deterministic replay exception is permissible only when the scorer/runtime has separately established that attempt_id fixes the statistical attempt; the reservation ledger itself does not prove determinism.
Process-epoch MAC permits prevent accidentally persisting and reusing a pre-crash launch permit. Recovery requires a new decision from durable state.
Reservation COMMIT is launch-control bookkeeping bound to a scientific SLOT-event digest; the main ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE journal remains score truth.
Two-file reservation/main-journal disagreement must fail closed. No atomic cross-file transaction is assumed.
frontier: Integrate AttemptLaunchPermit into the score-launch wrapper so the scorer is invoked only after both durable ADMIT capability and durable one-attempt reservation permit validate.

On successful durable SLOT append, durably append reservation COMMIT with the exact SLOT-event digest; crash-inject score-complete/SLOT-append/reservation-COMMIT boundaries and verify fail-closed recovery.
If actual launchers can have concurrent OS processes, add flock/lease/fencing to reservation writer and stress simultaneous same-slot reservation races.
For the fail-closed policy, ensure block CLOSE naturally counts an uncommitted reserved slot as missing/failure=1 without any retry path.
Byte-execute all current artifacts against exact production durable adapter/V3/K-guard siblings in a repository-local runtime.
exact_next_action: Create a reservation-aware score-launch wrapper that validates both LaunchCapability and same-process AttemptLaunchPermit before scorer invocation, requires result.attempt_id to equal the durable reservation, persists SLOT through prepare_slot_authorized, and then writes reservation COMMIT bound to the exact SLOT event digest; crash-inject every boundary so a reserved-but-uncommitted stochastic attempt never gets silently replaced by a different result.
